companies.name: トラクターズ・アンド・ファーム・イクイップメント

relations.text: 完成トラクターの調達先だったが、2024年4月に取引を全面停止
relations.text_en: Former tractor supplier; AGCO ended all commercial ties in April 2024

source.label: AGCO 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On April 26, 2024, we gave notice to TAFE that the Company was terminating all of its commercial relationships with TAFE.

relations.text: 完成トラクターを購入する調達先の一社
relations.text_en: Buys fully manufactured tractors from it

source.label: AGCO 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We purchase some fully manufactured tractors from Tractors and Farm Equipment Limited ("TAFE"), SDF S.p.A., Carraro S.p.A. and Iseki & Company, Limited.

companies.name: タイタン・インターナショナル
companies.sub: 農機用ホイール・タイヤ

relations.text: 主要顧客の筆頭としてAGCOを挙げる
relations.text_en: Lists AGCO first among its key customers

source.label: Titan International 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Customers including AGCO Corporation, Caterpillar Inc., CNH Global N.V., Deere & Company

relations.text: 農業事業を出資し、精密農業の合弁PTx Trimbleを設立
relations.text_en: Contributed its ag business to the PTx Trimble precision ag joint venture

source.label: Trimble 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: On September 28, 2023, we executed a Sale and Contribution Agreement with AGCO that provided for the formation of a joint venture, called PTx Trimble

relations.text: 販売金融の合弁AGCO Financeの過半を保有(AGCOは49%)
relations.text_en: Holds the majority of the AGCO Finance joint ventures (AGCO 49%)

source.label: AGCO 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: AGCO Finance equity joint ventures are structured with AGCO holding a 49% ownership interest, with the remaining interest owned by a wholly owned subsidiary of Rabobank.

relations.text: Deereが10-Kで、農業機械の世界的な競合の筆頭に挙げる
relations.text_en: Deere lists AGCO first among global agriculture competitors

source.label: Deere 10-K(2025年10月期)
source.quote: The competitive environment for the agriculture and turf operations includes some global competitors, such as AGCO Corporation

relations.text: CNHが10-Kで、農業機械の主な競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: CNH names AGCO among principal agricultural equipment competitors

source.label: CNH 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our principal competitors in the agricultural equipment market are Deere & Company, AGCO Corporation, Claas Group
